

# cleanmgr.exe is all Rust (cleanmgr-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/cleanmgr-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# cleanmgr.cpp  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/cleanmgr-rust/src/cleanmgr/cleanmgr_cpp_h.rs)
# CSelectDriveDlg.cpp  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/cleanmgr-rust/src/cleanmgr/CSelectDriveDlg_cpp_h.rs)
# CCleanupHandler.cpp  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/cleanmgr-rust/src/cleanmgr/CCleanupHandler_cpp_h.rs)
# CCleanupHandlerList.cpp  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/cleanmgr-rust/src/cleanmgr/CCleanupHandlerList_cpp_h.rs)
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(cleanmgr_shims OBJECT rust_cohab_stub.cpp)
target_link_libraries(cleanmgr_shims PRIVATE uuid cpprt atl_classes libshlwapi liboleaut32 libole32 libshell32 libcomctl32 libuser32 libadvapi32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
target_compile_definitions(cleanmgr_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
add_dependencies(cleanmgr_shims psdk)
add_cargo_module(cleanmgr cleanmgr-cargo cleanmgr.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE cleanmgr-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS cleanmgr_shims psdk uuid_sources xdk)
